title: Strategy reports wider-than-expected Q2 loss amid Bitcoin volatility
text: Strategy (NASDAQ:MSTR) shares fell 7% in pre-market trading after the company reported a wider-than-expected second quarter loss, largely driven by unrealized losses on its Bitcoin holdings. The company reported a net loss of $8.22 billion, or $24.45 per diluted share, for the three months ended June 30, compared with net income of $10.02 billion, or $32.60 per share, in the year-ago period.
